alignment_review.expected_opening: Water at the window / Fire in the chest / They told me, Pick one / I carried both.
alignment_review.observed_opening: I hear the lock click. / I hear the clock tick. / Pressure made a language in, and I talk it.
alignment_review.gate: Do not approve lyric-locked scene timing until the artist authority confirms the vocal master or supplies a matching authoritative vocal master.

scenes.lyric: Water at the window / Fire in the chest / They told me, pick one
scenes.action: KTD touches a rain-streaked window, breathes, then walks through shallow floodwater toward camera with an amber flame reflected in the street.

scenes.lyric: Six lives in a small room / rain tapping on the tin
scenes.action: KTD crosses a narrow room with water marks climbing the walls; a swinging lamp, rain and footstep ripples remain alive.

scenes.lyric: Grandma kept a candle / hold the door
scenes.action: KTD lights a small protected flame and braces a metal door against pressure from rising water.

scenes.lyric: Black boy in a white room
scenes.action: KTD advances through a harsh white institutional room while anonymous silhouettes obstruct the route and fluorescent lights pulse.

scenes.lyric: They measured my mistakes / carved a different answer
scenes.action: KTD marks wet concrete with charcoal, taps the rhythm with his knuckles and turns into a restrained performance gesture.

scenes.lyric: Old hunger / turned the pressure into flame
scenes.action: KTD crosses a service corridor through water and vapor as cold light gradually yields to amber fire reflection.

scenes.lyric: If the river wants my roots / city wants my silence
scenes.action: KTD walks against a shallow current, touches a wet street pole and opens the first melodic contour toward camera.

scenes.lyric: I brought the storm into the booth
scenes.action: KTD enters the recording booth, takes the microphone and moves through real hanging cables as rain and LEDs respond.

scenes.lyric: Fire in the flood / keep the flame alive
scenes.action: KTD power-walks through a flooded street carrying a protected flame; every step creates moving water, vapor and reflections.

scenes.lyric: Say my name — KTD — watch the whole room rise
scenes.action: KTD performs in a wet warehouse as anonymous silhouettes rise behind him and amber lights activate across the room.

scenes.lyric: Learned the cables / learned the code
scenes.action: KTD crosses a technical studio, activates a patchbay and sends a visible wave of LEDs through the control room.

scenes.lyric: Put a ladder by the wall / six futures in the frame
scenes.action: KTD positions a ladder against a flooded wall, helps an anonymous young silhouette climb and then looks toward six distant lights.

scenes.lyric: Won’t dress the wound / show you how we lift
scenes.action: On a wet rooftop KTD crosses the frame, rejects an open cage-like doorway and turns toward a real exit as wind and rain move.

scenes.lyric: Fast tongue / problem multiplied / not a villain, not a saint
scenes.action: KTD performs in a concrete tunnel while the camera dollies backward, lateral rain crosses the lens and light bands pass over his face.

scenes.lyric: Fire in the flood / who’s that at the door — KTD
scenes.action: KTD opens a heavy metal door, steps into warm light and answers the camera directly while water drains over the threshold.

scenes.lyric: I used to think that being hard / stronger when it carries more than one
scenes.action: KTD crosses an empty wet room, slows, places his forehead against rain-covered glass and lets breath and condensation appear.

scenes.lyric: If the tears hit the floor / fire through the flood / Water at the window / KTD
scenes.action: Close live-action finish: KTD returns to the lens through rain, the amber reflection disappears from the window and he exits frame before a hard cut to black.
